No energy, no waiting, no loot boxes, and nothing to buy that makes you stronger.

• Drag to fly. Your ship flies above your thumb and moves further than your thumb does, so a short move takes it far. It fires by itself.
• Only the small bright core of your ship can be hit. Let bullets pass close: every one that crosses the gold ring around the core charges your Overdrive, your special attack.
• Fire the Overdrive and every bullet on the screen turns into gold.
• Lift your thumb and time stands still. Find the gap, then fly on.

100 LEVELS, 34 BOSSES

• At level 100 waits the Astrarium itself, the hardest fight in the game.

The parcels are purring. Best get them home.

Cats by Post is a cosy logic puzzle game about cats in boxes. Place turntables, work out a route and send the post. Your job is to get every cat to the right basket. Their job is to curl up in it.

Start with a few simple deliveries in the Sorting Office, then follow the post through a busy depot, aboard the mail train and into the Great Postal Vault. Gates change direction, paired tunnels open up new routes, and bigger cats take things at their own pace. That neat little plan might need another look.

There’s plenty to keep the sorting desk busy:
- 100 puzzles, with new twists as your postal round grows.
- Today’s Post: a fresh puzzle every day.
- Practice puzzles and Night Shift for when you fancy another delivery.
- Cat photographs to collect as you bring more cats home in Night Shift.
